instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a shallow depth of field, captured in a full shot at eye-level. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing, two women are playfully interacting. On the left, the woman in the beige hoodie (R1) steps forward in grey leggings and pink sneakers, holding hands with the woman in the grey hijab (R3) on the right, who wears a pink jacket, white pants, and pink sneakers. Both women are looking down at their feet, laughing and smiling joyfully as they dance together. Soft, natural daylight with a warm tone highlights their expressions, while the edges of the frame are softly blurred.
